deposit_callable_by_any_address.meaning: deposit() can be called by any address on behalf of any recipient without access control

deposit_minimum_amount_wei.meaning: minimum deposit amount required per deposit entry (report states no minimum, 1-wei accepted)

victim_ghybr_balance.meaning: victim's gHYBR token balance held before the attack

lock_expiry_hours.meaning: duration after which a deposit lock entry expires

victim_transfer_completes.meaning: victim's token transfer completes successfully within Hyperliquid's 30M gas slow block limit regardless of the number of lock entries in userLocks[victim]
victim_transfer_completes.checkpoint: after attacker deposits, during victim transfer

victim_withdraw_rebalance_completes.meaning: victim can withdraw and rebalance positions (operations that also invoke the token transfer path and thus _cleanExpired()) during market volatility
victim_withdraw_rebalance_completes.checkpoint: after attacker deposits, during victim withdraw/rebalance

assumptions: Attacker deposits thousands of 1-wei entries into userLocks[victim] before the victim's transfer, withdraw, or rebalance.
The victim's transfer, withdraw, and rebalance operations invoke _beforeTokenTransfer() which calls _cleanExpired() over the full userLocks array.
Hyperliquid slow block gas limit is 30M as stated in the intent.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a per-lock gas cost or exact array length at which cleanup exceeds the 30M block gas limit, so the numeric threshold linking lock count to transfer/withdraw/rebalance failure cannot be derived; completion obligations are kept as grounded Booleans.
Report does not fully specify whether lock entries must be expired at cleanup time for the DoS, nor the exact re-deposit cadence sustaining it.

limitations: Withdraw and rebalance completion are encoded as a single grounded Boolean because the report does not separately define their gas behavior beyond sharing the transfer cleanup path.
Gas-limit exceedance is represented as Boolean completion observables rather than a numeric gas comparison because per-lock gas is not reported.
Direct financial losses are a downstream consequence of the completion failures and are not separately encoded.
